The experience

Your stay at Carlton Ridge

Six bedrooms, expansive gardens and a private pool, with the Caribbean just moments away. One very special place to stay in Barbados.

Four bedrooms in the main residence, plus a completely self-contained two-bedroom garden residence — giving everyone the freedom to be together, or have space of their own.

There is a particular pleasure to having your own residence in Barbados.

Breakfast when you feel like it. A few hours in the sunshine. A swim in the Caribbean Sea before lunch. Sunset drinks on the terrace. Dinner outside while the evening stretches on.

Carlton Ridge gives everyone room to be together — without everyone having to do the same thing.

This is Barbados at an unhurried pace.

The main residence

Space to be together

Four en suite bedrooms and open-plan living spaces, with high ceilings and ceiling fans that carry the sea breeze through — a home made to be lived in, not just photographed.

Tour the Residence

The garden residence

Space to be yourself

A self-contained two-bedroom retreat in the garden, with its own kitchen, living room and terrace.

Discover the Garden Residence

Two residences, one holiday

Together, with room to breathe

Four bedrooms in the main house. Two more in a separate garden residence.

Carlton Ridge works particularly well for families and groups travelling together.

The two-bedroom garden residence has its own kitchen, living space and terrace, giving grandparents, older children, friends or staff the freedom to have their own space while remaining part of the same holiday.

More than a villa

It feels less like booking a large villa — and more like having your own private Barbados estate for the week.

Life outdoors

Days are meant to be spent outside

Slow mornings in the sunshine. Sunset drinks on the terrace. Barbecue dinners beneath the Caribbean sky.

The West Coast of Barbados

Everything close. Your own space to come home to.

Carlton Ridge sits on Barbados’ West Coast, close to the calm Caribbean waters that make this side of the island so special.

The beach is close by, while Holetown, Speightstown, restaurants, golf and some of Barbados’ best-known beaches are all within easy reach.

Close enough to enjoy everything. Far enough away to come home and switch off.
